title: Detection != Reliable Control: Decodable Empathy Directions Yield at Most Partial Shifts in Automated Empathy Scores
abstract: arXiv:2608.24901v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A decodable "empathy" direction is routinely read as a causal lever, conflating decodability, automated-metric control, and human-perceived change. We test this for two EPITOME-derived facets -- Recognition (cognitive) and Resonance (affective) -- in three instruction-tuned LLMs, scoring every intervention with two LLM judges and a discriminative EPITOME classifier, each gated by an emotional-vs-neutral positive control. The control passes for the affective facet across all automated instruments, but cognitive range is inconsistent across them. Both facets remain decodable after residualizing against a sentence-embedding-derived surface score, and steering can substantially rewrite the text. Yet adding the Resonance direction raises the affective score only partially -- in Qwen by +0.29 (approximately 26% of the natural gap). translated_title: 检测不等于可靠控制：可解码的共情方向在自动化共情评分中仅产生部分偏移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24901v1 公告类型：新 摘要：一个可解码的“共情”方向通常被视为因果杠杆，混淆了可解码性、自动化指标控制和人类感知变化。我们针对两个EPITOME衍生维度——识别（认知）和共鸣（情感）——在三个指令微调的大语言模型中进行测试，使用两个LLM评判器和一个判别式EPITOME分类器对每次干预进行评分，每个评判器均通过情感与中性阳性对照进行门控。对照在情感维度上通过了所有自动化工具，但认知范围在不同工具间不一致。在残差化处理句子嵌入衍生的表面分数后，两个维度仍保持可解码性，且引导可以大幅改写文本。然而，添加共鸣方向仅部分提高了情感分数——在Qwen中提高了+0.29（约占自然差距的26%）。直接的维度间对比确认了该偏移在Qwen和Llama中具有维度特异性（Gemma中不显著）；我们不提供进一步建议。
tldr: 本文发现可解码的共情方向虽能部分提升自动化情感评分，但效果有限且不一致，表明可解码性不等于可靠的因果控制。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that decodable empathy directions yield only partial and inconsistent shifts in automated empathy scores, indicating decodability does not equate to reliable causal control.
